label: mesh-plugin-register-added
context: Added register(ctx) function to mesh plugin at ~/.hermes/plugins/evey-mesh/__init__.py. The plugin had all 4 tool functions (mesh_status, mesh_message, mesh_task, mesh_lock) but no register() entry point, so Hermes couldn't load any of them. Added register() that calls ctx.register_tool() for each with proper JSON schemas. Also fixed plugin.yaml to use provides_hooks instead of hooks, and cleared all __pycache__ for both mesh and distillation plugins. The distillation plugin also needs gateway restart (pre_tool_call hook wasn't loading due to stale .pyc cache from previous session).
